testResults.name: option-expiry-exercise-assignment
testResults.result: 24 tests passed covering the OptionLifecycle: deterministic long exercise at exact strike-price settlement, pessimistic full in-the-money short assignment through the injectable AssignmentPolicy with cash settlement of any unassigned remainder, worthless and pinned expiry, days-to-expiry threshold events, contract retirement registry, rejection of orders in expired contracts, and expired-contract rejection on late fills; all money math is exact Decimal and timing flows through the injected clock

testResults.name: repository-quality-gates
commands: uv run --python 3.12 --extra dev ruff check src/harness tests/harness
testResults.result: Scoped Ruff and repository-wide ty checks passed after wave integration

limitations: Option fills book cash exactly as quantity times price; the multiplier converts contracts to shares only at settlement, so fill producers must quote per-contract notional prices — T119 collateral checks and the runner must adopt the same convention
